compute_mode.description: localonly = no network calls permitted. remoteapproved = requires network_fallback.userpromptrequired=true at the root level.

model_registry.description: Full visible list of providers, including blocked ones. Blocked entries stay in this list with allowed=false so nothing is hidden from the user.

blocked.description: Visible in every selection UI, permanently allowed=false. Never removed from display, never selectable.

then.description: remoteapproved mode requires explicit root-level network_fallback consent gate — enforced via cross-schema reference at validation time, not silently.
